paragraphs: Pfizer Inc. ( FY-zər) is an American multinational pharmaceutical and biotechnology corporation headquartered at The Spiral in Manhattan, New York City. Founded in 1849 in New York by German entrepreneurs Charles Pfizer and Charles F. Erhart, Pfizer is one of the oldest pharmaceutical companies in North America.

Pfizer develops and produces medication and vaccines for immunology, oncology, cardiology, endocrinology, and neurology. The company's largest products by sales are Eliquis (apixaban) ($7.9 billion in 2025 revenues, 13% of total revenues), Prevnar (a pneumococcal conjugate vaccine) ($6.5 billion in 2025 revenues, 10% of total revenues), Paxlovid (Nirmatrelvir/ritonavir) ($2.4 billion in 2025 revenues, 4% of total revenues), Vyndaqel (tafamidis) ($6.4 billion in 2025 revenues, 10% of total revenues), Comirnaty (the Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine) ($4.4 billion in 2025 revenues, 7% of total revenues), and Ibrance (palbociclib) ($4.1 billion in 2025 revenues, 7% of total revenues). In 2025, 59% of the company's revenues came from the United States, 5% came from China, and 36% came from other countries.
The company is ranked fifth on the list of largest biomedical companies by revenue. It is ranked the 69th on the Fortune 500 and 73rd on the Forbes Global 2000.

people.name: Payal Sahni
people.title: Chief People Experience Officer, Executive Vice President
people.bio: Chief People Experience Officer, Executive Vice President since January 2022, after serving as Chief Human Resources Officer, Executive Vice President from June 2020 to December 2021. Joined Pfizer in 1997 and has held positions of increasing responsibility in the Human Resources organization.
people.quote: Payal Sahni | | 51 | | Chief People Experience Officer, Executive Vice President since January 2022.

people.name: Ronald E. Blaylock
people.title: Director
people.bio: Founder and Managing Partner of GenNx360 Capital Partners since 2006. Previously founded and managed Blaylock & Company and held senior management positions at UBS, PaineWebber Group and Citicorp.
people.quote: Mr. Blaylock's extensive experience in private equity and investment banking brings business leadership, financial expertise and risk management skills to the Board.

people.name: Albert Bourla
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Chief Executive Officer of Pfizer since January 2019 and Chairman of the Board since January 2020. Joined Pfizer in 1993 and previously served as Chief Operating Officer and in several global leadership roles.
people.quote: Since joining Pfizer in 1993, Dr. Bourla has served in various leadership positions with increasing responsibility within Pfizer's former Animal Health and global commercial organizations.

people.name: Mortimer J. Buckley
people.title: Director
people.bio: Independent Pfizer director since 2024 and a 2026 director nominee. Serves on the Audit and Governance Committees.
people.quote: and Messrs. Ronald E. Blaylock, Mortimer J. Buckley, Joseph J. Echevarria, Shantanu Narayen, James Quincey, James C. Smith and Cyrus Taraporevala.

people.name: Susan Desmond-Hellmann
people.title: Director
people.bio: Independent Pfizer director since 2020 and a 2026 director nominee. Chairs the Science and Technology Committee and serves on the Governance Committee.
people.quote: The independent Directors are Drs. Susan Desmond-Hellmann, Scott Gottlieb, Susan Hockfield and Dan R. Littman;

people.name: Joseph J. Echevarria
people.title: Director
people.bio: Independent Pfizer director since 2015 and a 2026 director nominee. Chairs the Governance Committee and serves on the Audit Committee.
people.quote: and Messrs. Ronald E. Blaylock, Mortimer J. Buckley, Joseph J. Echevarria, Shantanu Narayen, James Quincey, James C. Smith and Cyrus Taraporevala.

people.name: Scott Gottlieb
people.title: Director
people.bio: Senior Fellow of the American Enterprise Institute and a Pfizer director since 2019. Chairs the Regulatory and Compliance Committee and serves on the Science and Technology Committee.
people.quote: Dr. Gottlieb is a Senior Fellow of the American Enterprise Institute (AEI).

people.name: Susan Hockfield
people.title: Director
people.bio: Current independent Pfizer director scheduled to retire from the Board in April 2026. Serves on the Regulatory and Compliance and Science and Technology Committees.
people.quote: In April 2026, Dr. Hockfield will retire from the Board and as a member of the Regulatory and Compliance and Science and Technology Committees.

people.name: Dan R. Littman
people.title: Director
people.bio: Independent Pfizer director since 2018 and a 2026 director nominee. Serves on the Governance, Regulatory and Compliance, and Science and Technology Committees.
people.quote: The independent Directors are Drs. Susan Desmond-Hellmann, Scott Gottlieb, Susan Hockfield and Dan R. Littman;

people.name: Shantanu Narayen
people.title: Lead Independent Director
people.bio: Chief executive officer of Adobe Inc. Has served as Pfizer's Lead Independent Director since the 2018 Annual Meeting and is an ex-officio member of each Board committee.
people.quote: The independent Directors also determined to re-elect Mr. Shantanu Narayen as Lead Independent Director in 2026.

people.title: Director

people.quote: Ms. Suzanne Nora Johnson; and Messrs. Ronald E. Blaylock, Mortimer J. Buckley, Joseph J. Echevarria,

people.name: James Quincey
people.title: Director
people.bio: Chairman of The Coca-Cola Company since 2019 and CEO since 2017, having previously held several leadership roles there. The text states he will step down as CEO effective March 31, 2026 and continue as Executive Chairman.
people.quote: Mr. Quincey also brings expertise in information technology to Pfizer's Board.

people.name: James C. Smith
people.title: Director
people.bio: Chairman of the Thomson Reuters Foundation. Served as President and Chief Executive Officer of Thomson Reuters from 2012 through March 2020, following earlier leadership roles at Thomson Reuters and Thomson Corporation.
people.quote: Mr. Smith's previous experience leading global Human Resources for The Thomson Corporation informs his strong advocacy for culture and talent development.

people.name: Cyrus Taraporevala
people.title: Director
people.bio: President and Chief Executive Officer of State Street Global Advisors from 2017 until 2022. Previously held leadership roles at several asset-management firms and spent 14 years at McKinsey & Company.
people.quote: Mr. Taraporevala's extensive experience as President and CEO of State Street Global Advisors has endowed him with exceptional executive leadership skills in investment management
